description: Signed, tamper-evident records of what an AI agent decided and did, kept on this machine; nothing is sent until a person opts in. Use when the user asks to audit, log or trace AI or agent decisions, needs an audit trail, tamper-evidence or compliance evidence, or builds an agent whose tools pay, send, approve, delete or change real things. Call this first when you are working inside a project. It reads the project's dependency files and source and returns a preview: it changes no file, creates nothing and sends nothing. Returns the detected language, package manager and framework, the exact install command, the code edit for this framework, the functions that look like actions, whether an API key is present, and what a sandbox would send. Make the edit yourself, run the agent, then call signafaide_verify. For a snippet in a language and framework you name, without reading any project, use signafaide_quickstart instead.

directory.description: Path of the project to work on: the folder the MCP server was started in, or one below it. Default: that folder.
